scripts.build: npm run check:env && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--no-deprecation next build
scripts.db:migrate: npm run check:env && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--no-deprecation PAYLOAD_CONFIG_PATH=src/payload.config.ts payload migrate
scripts.db:status: npm run check:env && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--no-deprecation PAYLOAD_CONFIG_PATH=src/payload.config.ts payload migrate:status
scripts.dev: npm run check:env && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--no-deprecation next dev
scripts.generate:importmap: npm run check:env && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--no-deprecation PAYLOAD_CONFIG_PATH=src/payload.config.ts payload generate:importmap
scripts.generate:types: npm run check:env && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--no-deprecation PAYLOAD_CONFIG_PATH=src/payload.config.ts payload generate:types
scripts.import:poc: cross-env NODE_ENV=production npm run check:env && cross-env NODE_ENV=production tsx src/catalog/import-cli.ts
scripts.import:catalog: cross-env NODE_ENV=production npm run check:env && cross-env NODE_ENV=production tsx src/catalog/full-import-cli.ts
scripts.payload: npm run check:env && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--no-deprecation PAYLOAD_CONFIG_PATH=src/payload.config.ts payload
scripts.snapshot:poc: cross-env NODE_ENV=production npm run check:env && cross-env NODE_ENV=production tsx src/catalog/export-cli.ts
scripts.start: npm run check:env && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--no-deprecation next start
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
